question: For male legislators from Louisiana, how many distinct legislators were actively serving on December 31 of each year from more than 30 years since their first term up to less than 50 years, grouping the results by the exact number of years elapsed since their first term?
sql:
WITH la_male_legislators AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT l.id_bioguide
    FROM legislators l
    JOIN legislators_terms lt ON l.id_bioguide = lt.id_bioguide
    WHERE l.gender = 'M' AND lt.state = 'LA'
),
first_terms AS (
    SELECT id_bioguide, MIN(term_start::DATE) AS first_term_start
    FROM legislators_terms lt
    WHERE id_bioguide IN (SELECT id_bioguide FROM la_male_legislators)
    GROUP BY id_bioguide
),
year_series AS (
    SELECT (1800 + n)::INTEGER AS yr
    FROM generate_series(0, 225) AS g(n)
),
dec31_dates AS (
    SELECT yr, (yr || '-12-31')::DATE AS dec31
    FROM year_series
),
legislators_serving AS (
    SELECT 
        lt.id_bioguide,
        ft.first_term_start,
        d31.yr AS active_year,
        d31.dec31,
        CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM d31.dec31) AS INTEGER) - CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM ft.first_term_start) AS INTEGER) AS years_elapsed
    FROM legislators_terms lt
    JOIN first_terms ft ON lt.id_bioguide = ft.id_bioguide
    JOIN dec31_dates d31 ON 1=1
    WHERE lt.id_bioguide IN (SELECT id_bioguide FROM la_male_legislators)
    AND d31.dec31 >= lt.term_start::DATE
    AND d31.dec31 <= lt.term_end::DATE
)
SELECT 
    years_elapsed,
    COUNT(DISTINCT id_bioguide) AS distinct_legislators
FROM legislators_serving
WHERE years_elapsed > 30 AND years_elapsed < 50
GROUP BY years_elapsed
ORDER BY years_elapsed
